title: Blueprint Receipt
description: Receipt produced after Blueprint writes a blueprint.json and human Attestation is obtained.

blueprint_path.description: Full path to the written blueprint.json.

change_type.description: Whether this modifies an existing module or creates a net-new one.

benchmark_gate_count.description: Number of benchmark gates defined in blueprint.json.

attestation_received.description: Whether human Attestation was obtained. Must be true before Augment or Factory starts.

open_questions_surfaced.description: Questions surfaced to human before blueprint was written.
